title: Visitor and Choir
author: Z. M. Reyes
blurb: Ulyana Dravenmoor, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, has spent fifteen years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must finish the ritual the founders started before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
